new_fixed_findings.fact: One PermissionError during removal stopped cleanup of remaining owned files/directories.
new_fixed_findings.fix: Attempt every owned removal; collect errors with original failure in BaseExceptionGroup.
new_fixed_findings.impact: Failed artifact extraction only; normal cleanup remains unchanged.
new_fixed_findings.acceptance: CRC+unlink failure removes other removable file, retains locked file and original CRC/removal errors; directory failure does not skip other directory; cancellation plus cleanup failure both retained.
new_fixed_findings.limit: Operating-system-denied removal is reported as incomplete, not falsely claimed erased.

new_fixed_findings.fact: Returned artifact.id and run.id were not compared with request marker IDs; unknown expiry could be treated as false.
new_fixed_findings.fix: Returned IDs must be exact integers equal to marker locators; expired must be False.
new_fixed_findings.impact: Stage provenance preflight, before artifact download.
new_fixed_findings.acceptance: Wrong IDs, bool/float artifact IDs and unknown expiry reject before download; ordinary fixtures pass.
new_fixed_findings.limit: No evidence that real GitHub returned mismatched IDs or production inventory was corrupted.

new_fixed_findings.fact: Reused --output could overwrite old results; direct final-path write followed by fsync+unlink double failure could leave a successful-looking JSON.
new_fixed_findings.fix: Reject existing/linked destination before stress; write and flush/fsync same-directory temporary JSON, then exclusive os.link publication; preserve old/racing evidence; retain double errors.
new_fixed_findings.impact: Both opt-in offline stress CLIs only.
new_fixed_findings.acceptance: Both CLIs reject existing output before stress; exclusive full JSON publication works; fsync failure removes new private output, fsync+cleanup double failure leaves no final success JSON, publication race preserves foreign result and cleans private temp. Full optimized CLI runs also publish new reports successfully.
new_fixed_findings.limit: A report published after successful fsync remains valid if later private-temp deletion fails; that cleanup error is raised. Directory crash durability and adversarial replacement are not guaranteed.

new_fixed_findings.fact: Inner flags bit5 patched-data and bit6 strong-encryption passed preflight and were rejected only later by ZipFile reading.
new_fixed_findings.fix: Both outer/inner preflight reject flag mask 1|0x20|0x40.
new_fixed_findings.impact: Earlier rejection of unsupported transport formats; no frozen-producer format change.
new_fixed_findings.acceptance: Inner flag32/64 reject before reads; outer flag32/64 reject before writes; STORE/DEFLATE regression remains passing.
new_fixed_findings.limit: Previously these packages still failed later; do not claim successful malicious publication.
